status: Historical baseline audit; authorized cleanup implemented on QOL. See docs/rom-space-cleanup.md for implementation, measured savings and validation limits.

user_decisions.multiplayer: Remove all original multiplayer, including link trades/battles, Union Room/chat, wireless minigames, record mixing and obsolete external-device services; preserve NPC trades.
user_decisions.sevii: Remove original Sevii content, including Trainer Tower, Navel Rock, Birth Island and prototype islands; preserve shared assets and the boat system needed for Vidra.
user_decisions.debug: Development builds only; keep tools/source in the project.
user_decisions.teachy_tv: Remove, including exclusive skipped tutorial content; retain ordinary rival battles and naming/gender selection.
user_decisions.help_system: Remove contextual help and L/R overlay.
user_decisions.game_corner: Keep Celadon slots, coins and prizes.
user_decisions.species_roster: Keep all Generation 1–9 base species, moves, learnsets and cries. Selected form exclusions are separate.
user_decisions.regional_forms: Keep Alolan, Galarian, Hisuian and Paldean forms/evolutions.
user_decisions.fusion_forms: Remove fusion forms, retaining base species.
user_decisions.pikachu_costumes: Remove Cosplay/cap variants; retain ordinary Pikachu/Raichu and regional forms.
user_decisions.original_intro: Remove original Gengar/Nidorino opening movie; keep Quantum title, required boot checks and shared graphics/audio.
user_decisions.area_artwork: Keep illustrated entry screens for retained locations.
user_decisions.japanese: English-only; Japanese-only assets are conditional removal candidates after retained text/old-save dependencies are resolved.
user_decisions.seafoam: Remove caves; replace Route 20 crossing and relocate Articuno.
user_decisions.league_rematches: Keep League replay with original teams; remove stronger rematch teams and obsolete Sevii gate.
user_decisions.physical_pcs: Remove physical storage terminals; preserve story-essential computers such as Bill’s machine and other non-storage story props.
user_decisions.pc_actions: Move Pokémon release and box renaming to PokéGlass before retiring classic PC access; retain storage/save/caught-Pokémon transfer logic.
user_decisions.mail: Remove Mail/phrase editor/PC mailbox; adjust Jynx NPC trade and migrate existing stored/held Mail safely.
user_decisions.diploma: Remove Pokédex-completion diploma display; preserve seen/caught tracking and ordinary NPC dialogue.
user_decisions.unused_legacy: Include verified unused legacy assets, prototype maps and Hoenn decoration catalogue; preserve shared normal furniture/map tiles.
user_decisions.daycare: Keep daycare, breeding and egg support for Vidra/Havora; remove original Four Island location.
user_decisions.empty_trainer_slides: Compact empty tables while retaining future trainer-dialogue support.
user_decisions.deduplication: Share byte-identical read-only assets after checking pointer identity, alignment and palette usage; retain features/appearance.
user_decisions.footprints: Remove footprint graphics after confirming no retained screen uses them.
user_decisions.vivillon: Keep one wing pattern; exact retained pattern/migration mapping to be chosen during implementation.
user_decisions.alcremie: Keep one cream/sweet appearance; choose canonical appearance and migration mapping during implementation.
user_decisions.unown: Keep one letter form; choose canonical letter/migration mapping during implementation.
user_decisions.natural_color_forms: Keep Shellos/Gastrodon colors, flower colors, Deerling/Sawsbuck seasons, Minior colors and other retained natural variants.
user_decisions.gender_differences: Keep cosmetic male/female sprites; mechanical gender forms also remain.
user_decisions.save_compatibility: Preserve existing QOL saves; keep IDs/layout stable or provide migration before any removed data is accessed.
user_decisions.audio: Keep audio for Vidra, including removed-content music/SFX. Do not budget audio savings without revisiting this choice; preserve retained-species cries and shared instruments.
user_decisions.move_reminder: Keep relearning engine/service for Vidra; remove Two Island location.
user_decisions.lost_rewards: Preserve useful rewards and legendary encounters for replacement sources in Kanto or Vidra; source locations to be chosen during implementation.
user_decisions.solo_trade_evolution: Protect Linking Cord/evolution-item alternatives; audit missing item sources before link removal.
user_decisions.kanto_services: Keep fossil revival, move tutors/deleter, Name Rater, fishing, cycling and Itemfinder.
user_decisions.world_flavor: Keep ordinary NPC dialogue, signs and occupied houses; remove only content exclusive to selected removals.

candidates.dependency: Keep NPC trade presentation and shared battle/save/interrupt interfaces. Remove upstairs access/feature entry points; do not strip all trading code by filename.

candidates.feature: Original Sevii maps, quests, trainers and tower
candidates.dependency: Preserve boat engine for Vidra, shared Kanto tiles and all retained audio. Repair Kanto Bill/League/Celio flags; preserve/reassign HMs, legends and useful services.
Disable legacy boot hotkeys/communication entry paths. Preserve required normal cartridge boot/header behavior. Overlaps multiplayer bucket.
Keep rival story scene; remove gadget handoff and exclusive journals/flags/text/graphics. Preserve item/flag ID slots.
Keep naming/gender, ordinary rival battles, caught-Pokémon rules and shared Party/battle UI. Intro naming resource code is not all dead.
Remove help entry points and exclusive resources; preserve L/R and normal text/window functions used by tablet/gameplay.

candidates.feature: Mail, mailbox and exclusive phrase UI
candidates.dependency: Jynx NPC trade currently gives ITEM_FAB_MAIL. Preserve the trade, change its held reward, handle existing saved Mail, retain any Easy Chat use needed by kept code.

candidates.feature: Physical PC access and old PC UI
candidates.dependency: Classic storage is still reachable. Add release/box-renaming to PokéGlass first; preserve shared box data, item recovery, catching-to-box behavior, and story computers. Preserve Hall of Fame induction/records; no replacement historical viewer requested.
Relocate Mewtwo; repair cave entrance/guard, encounters and old saves located in the cave. Do not remove ordinary cave tiles shared elsewhere.
Provide Route 20 crossing, relocate Articuno, remove current/boulder alternate-layout references and remap old saved locations.
Keep Raikou/Entei/Suicune species and assets; strip roaming-only event hooks without breaking postgame Oak/National Dex state.
Keep original League teams replayable, Hall of Fame, game-clear flags and credits; remove absent-Lorelei/Celio gating and rematch-only parties without renumbering trainer IDs.
Keep ordinary trainers and avatar graphics shared with movement. Preserve save layout and trainer flags; do not blindly toggle FREE_MATCH_CALL.
Keep Dex counters, Oak ratings, ordinary NPC dialogue and core map.

Keep Quantum space/Minior title, required boot/save/RTC paths and retained audio. intro.c also handles boot/external-device paths. Old title code is largely already stripped; its wrapper is only 12 bytes.
Keep development tools/source, omit from release only; debug-only roots must not retain otherwise dead assets in a release build.

candidates.feature: Selected battle form groups and mechanics
candidates.dependency: Remove Gigantamax, special Tera forms, fusion, Ultra Burst, Z-Moves, Dynamax and Terastallization; preserve base species, regional/Mega/Primal systems, ordinary shared moves/animations, stable IDs and user-protected audio. Migrate stored forms first; filter randomizer/item/evolution paths.
Keep normal Pikachu/Raichu, regional forms and all functional base-species support. Rewrite selected-form references and saved variants.
Choose canonical pattern, update Scatterbug/Spewpa breeding/evolution defaults, randomizer and saved variants; not all named bytes are removable.
Keep species/natural form; migrate saved trim forms and retain shared assets/audio.
Choose canonical cream/sweet combination and preserve Milcery evolution, summary/icons, form-change and save handling.
Choose canonical letter, migrate saved forms/personality-dependent display and remove Tanoby-only encounter tables with Sevii.
Current tablet Dex does not display footprints, but native Dex rendering does. Remove only after resolving native screen entry roots and keeping species IDs/struct layout valid.

English-only decision does not justify deleting all international string helpers: retained game text and existing Japanese nicknames must be handled before dropping glyphs/render paths. Overlaps duplicate-font savings.
Both ROM arrays verified all-zero. Replace empty lookup storage while retaining valid lookup behavior, debug/tests and future dialogue capability.

Only identical payloads at distinct addresses counted. Four identical Latin glyph arrays alone duplicate 98,304 bytes. Verify pointer-identity assumptions, alignment and palette differences; keep seasons, gender differences and follower appearances. Overlaps removed-content buckets.

An unused name is not proof. 56 layouts lack map-header membership, but 20 have located runtime script/code references. gDecorations is rooted by Game Freak metadata; furniture tiles used on normal maps remain. Verify direct/indirect references and pointer-table slots before removal.

candidates.feature: Dormant DexNav and imported facility support
candidates.dependency: DexNav is disabled in config but code/hooks still link. Imported Battle Tower helpers may serve generic battle/test/save validation. Remove only unreachable/exclusive parts; preserve used hooks or safe stubs and save layout.

Tablet Dex uses its own field UI. Audit native entry points, shared Dex queries/render helpers and special tables before freeing exclusive resources. Do not delete Pokédex logic or active area artwork.

LTO defaults to 0; per-function/per-data sections are currently only added in the LTO path. Evaluate section-level collection separately while preserving required header, script and function-pointer roots. No savings measured and no build setting changed in this audit.

Only Normal is populated in the inspected trainer definitions; Easy/Hard fallback behavior and metadata access must be proven before representation changes. Do not remove difficulty functionality or renumber trainers by assumption.
